001package services;
002
003/**
004 * Convenience accessors for all singleton application services.
005 */
006public final class ServiceRegistry {
007    private ServiceRegistry() {}
008
009    public static AuthService auth() { return AuthService.getInstance(); }
010    public static MessageService messages() { return MessageService.getInstance(); }
011    public static NewsService news() { return NewsService.getInstance(); }
012    public static UserService users() { return UserService.getInstance(); }
013    public static CourseService courses() { return CourseService.getInstance(); }
014    public static MarkService marks() { return MarkService.getInstance(); }
015    public static ResearchService research() { return ResearchService.getInstance(); }
016}
